runner: Vitest with controlled test providers and isolated repositories

scenarios.name: slow healthy worker
scenarios.evidence: progress-watchdog: useful coder survives beyond former two-extension ceiling and remains cancellable
scenarios.limit: Scaled wall-clock harness, not a real 840-second provider run

scenarios.name: dead provider
scenarios.evidence: progress-watchdog: stalled provider is aborted with durable stalled reason

scenarios.name: activity loop
scenarios.evidence: r58-useful-progress rejects duplicate reads and failed calls; watchdog bounds extension count
scenarios.limit: No dedicated sustained oscillating-edit torture run

scenarios.name: checkpoint and continuation
scenarios.evidence: autonomous-orchestrator: expired productive coder checkpoint is durable and a sequential lease continues edits

scenarios.name: crash and restart
scenarios.evidence: autonomous-orchestrator restart recovery and checkpoint-certification restart/restore pass
scenarios.limit: Automatic relaunch of a budget-expired coder continuation after process death is unproven

scenarios.name: cancellation
scenarios.evidence: progress-watchdog cancellation and autonomous-orchestrator cancellation propagation/lease release pass

scenarios.name: verification failure
scenarios.evidence: autonomous-orchestrator verification failure blocks integration; completion-gate rejects missing, failed, and stale verification

scenarios.name: reviewer rejection
scenarios.evidence: autonomous-orchestrator blocking review causes corrective revision, then verification

scenarios.name: capacity churn
scenarios.evidence: pinned-route recovery handles a short 429 and bounds repeated failure
scenarios.limit: Mid-agent route migration is not established
